interface.longDescription: IONOS Bridge for Qumi Teknolojis, trading name of QROO Inc. Provides live discovery and execution of ALL IONOS Hosting MCP tools through dynamic MCP tools/list and tools/call instead of hardcoded operations. Includes domains, DNS, SSL, webhosting, WordPress, VPS, dedicated hosting and account/billing as exposed by IONOS to each authenticated account. Optional second upstream provider supports Cloudflare MCP tools; website analytics and redirects are available only when exposed by the connected provider. Each agent configures its own official HTTPS MCP endpoint and Personal Access Token with out-of-band masked credential entry or secret manager, never through chat or repository. Read-only access defaults to immediate execution; mutating calls require an exact, one-time operator approval. Cross-platform Node.js 20+ MCP stdio transport for Codex, Claude Code, Replit and other MCP hosts. A ChatGPT web connection requires a separately hosted, authenticated MCP service. Secure per-user credential questions use URL-mode MCP elicitation or a localhost browser fallback on Windows, Linux and macOS. The browser encrypts answers with RSA-OAEP/AES-GCM before local submission; the bridge stores AES-256-GCM ciphertext outside Git. No plaintext secret is collected through agent chat. Remote/cloud agents require an approved HTTPS credential portal or platform secret manager; URL question styling is controlled by the client.

name: ionos-bridge
description: Portable IONOS Hosting MCP gateway: dynamic discovery of every upstream tool, safe per-agent PAT provisioning, read-only default, approved mutations and optional Cloudflare MCP federation.
